subject: OKR spotlights, staging risks, and QBR dry-run agenda
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Leadership Distro <leadership@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: OKR spotlights, staging risks, and QBR dry-run agenda

Team — quick weekly snapshot ahead of QBR week. Please read and flag anything that needs to move to the escalation channel. I attached a proposed dry-run agenda and the latest OKR snapshot (team-level).

Wins (concise):
- Serving runtime: sustained 5% cost reduction after batching adjustments; production rollout completed Friday.
- Onboarding: 3 pilot customers onboarded to Dedicated tier this week (Acme Analytics moved to reserved capacity).

Risks / Staging issues (actionable):
- Data pipeline lag (staging->prod) causing delayed eval artifacts; estimated 2–3 hour nightly delta. Impact: QBR metrics for model-quality regressions may be incomplete.
  - Ask: need owner for root-cause RCA and quick mitigation (short-term: force-run nightly job).
- Slide rendering pipeline for demo kiosks fails on 4k images; workaround exists but will add 6–8 hours to playbook runbook prep.
  - Ask: can infra dedicate a 4-hour slot this week to validate alternative rendering binary?

QBR dry-run logistics:
- Proposed: Thu Nov 19, 10:00–11:30 PST (internal practice). Draft agenda attached.
- Prep asks: each lead brings a 5-min highlight slide + 1 slide for risks/asks. Please use attached slide-template.pptx.

Owners I propose:
- Data pipeline RCA & short-term rerun: Jonas
- Rendering binary validation: Kimberly + infra
- Customer-facing talking points (Acme analytics): Karthik

If you cannot own these, reply with alternate owner today EOD. I’ll lock the dry-run time by EOD Wednesday.

Thanks —
Marissa
Marissa Cole | Head, Operations Programs | Redwood Inference
attachments: QBR_dryrun_agenda_v1.pdf, OKR_snapshot_team-level_2026Q4.xlsx

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>

Marissa — I can take point on the data pipeline RCA and run the forced nightly job as a stopgap. Quick notes:
- I’ll kick off the RCA today and post a short incident summary to the ops channel by 16:00 PT.
- Short-term mitigation: I’ll schedule the forced rerun for tonight at 23:30 PT (will notify affected teams).

On the dry-run slot: Thu 10:00 works for me, but if leadership wants an earlier window to accommodate EMEA stakeholders, I can be flexible.

Jonas

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>

Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 08:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: OKR spotlights, staging risks, and QBR dry-run agenda

Thanks Marissa — Kimberly here. I’ll own the rendering binary validation with infra. Initial plan:
- Standup with infra tomorrow 9:30 PT to reproduce locally.
- If reproduces, we’ll test the alternative binary in a staging cluster and run the kiosk playbook.

Note on resourcing: current infra sprint is tight. To avoid delaying other tickets I request a 0.25 FTE for 1 week (contractor or reassign) to run the validation and follow-up fixes. If leadership approves, I’ll open a short-term headcount request in the portal and tag Hannah for budget.

Also: for Acme Analytics customer materials, Karthik and I can sync on the talking points — Karthik, ping me with any redlines.

—Kimberly
